summary: Workforce size estimates range widely: Herodotus 100,000; modern estimates 14,567 average / 40,000 peak (DMJM-Lehner study); Verner ~30,000; ~5,000 permanent salaried workers.
content: Workforce estimates: Herodotus cited 100,000; physicist Kurt Mendelssohn up to 50,000; Borchardt and Croon 36,000; Miroslav Verner no more than 30,000. DMJM-Lehner construction management study: average workforce 14,567, peak 40,000. Evidence suggests ~5,000 permanent workers on salaries, balance working 3-4 month shifts in lieu of taxes receiving subsistence wages of ten loaves of bread and a jug of beer per day. Zahi Hawass believes majority may have been volunteers. Two crews of ~2,000 subdivided into named gangs of 1,000, divided into five phyles of 200, split into groups of ~20.
